Subject: Approval Request: Six-Week Invoice Handling Pilot

Hi Morgan,

I’m writing to request approval to proceed with the proposed six-week pilot focused on assessing invoice handling.

The pilot is designed to evaluate opportunities to shorten handling time, with the client’s target of a 20% reduction serving as the intended benchmark. Because no baseline or measured savings currently exists, this assessment will provide the evidence needed to inform any future decisions. Production rollout is explicitly excluded from the pilot scope.

The proposed fee is a fixed $30,000 for the six-week pilot. Work would begin only after security approval is granted for access to client data; no start date has yet been approved.

Please confirm approval of the pilot scope and $30,000 fixed fee, subject to security clearance. Once approved, we can move the engagement into the security review process and align on a start date.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
